verses.en: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
verses.sm: Amaleka Ua oo Tavita ma ona tagata i Sekeleka i le aso tolu, a ua uma le osofia le itu i toga ma Sekeleka e Amaleka; ua fasia foi Sekeleka, ma ua faamuina i le au.

verses.en: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
verses.sm: Ua tafea foi fafine sa i ai, O e iti atoa ma e matutua; e lei fasiotia se tasi, a ua avea i latou, ma ua latou o.

verses.en: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
verses.sm: Ca oo atu Tavita ma ona tagata ile aai, faauta, ua mu ile afi,ao a latou ava, ma o latou atalii, ma o latou afafine ua tafea i latou.

verses.en: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
verses.sm: Ona fetagisi ai lea o Tavita ma le nuu sa ia te ia, ua leo tetele, ua 00 ina le toe lava ona tagi.

verses.en: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.sm: Ua tāfea foi ava a Tavita e toalua, o Ainoama le Isereelu, ma Apikaila le aya a Napalu le Karamelu.

verses.en: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
verses.sm: Ua atuatuvale tele lava Tavita, aua na tautala le nuu e fetogi ia te ia i maa, ina ua tiga loto o le nuu uma taitasi i ona atalii ma ona afafine; a ua faamalosi Tavita lona loto i le Aw lona Atua.

verses.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Tavita ia Aviata le faitaulaga, le atalii o Aimeleka, Ina au mai ia ia te au le efota; ona avatu ai lea e Aviata o le efota ia Tavita.

verses.en: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
verses.sm: Ona fesili lea o Tavita i le ALII, ua faapea atu, Ou te tuliloa ea i lena ‘au? ou te maua atu ea ia te i latou? Ona fetalai mai lea o ia ia te ia, Tuliloa ia, aua e te maua atu ai lava, ma e maua mai lava mea uma.

verses.en: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu Tavita, o ia ma tagata e toaono galau sa ia te ia, ua 00 i le alia o Pesora, ua nonofo ai e na nonofo.

verses.en: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
verses.sm: Ua tulituliloa e Tavita ma tagata e toafa galau, a ua nonofo le toalua selau na le lava e o atu ile la itu o le alia o Pesora.

verses.en: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
verses.sm: Ona latou maua lea le tagata Aikupito o le vao, ua avatu o ia ia Tavita; ua latou avane ia te ia se areto ua ‘ai ai, ma latou faainu ia te ia i le vai.

verses.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
verses.sm: Ua latou avatu foi ia te ia se fasi potopotogámati mamago ma fuifui vine mamago e lua; ua ‘ai o ia, ona toe foi mai lea o lona malosi ia te ia; aua e tolu ao e tolu foi po ua ia le “ai ni areto, ua le inu foi se vai.

verses.en: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita ia te ia, O ai ea oe? maifea foi oe? Ona fai mai lea o le taulealea, O aʻu le Aikupito, le auauna a le tagata Amaleka; na tuulafoai mai loʻu alii ia te au, aua na maua aʻu i le ta“ anapo lua.

verses.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
verses.sm: Na matou osofia le itu i toga o tagata Kereti, ma le laueleele o Iuta, ma le itu i toga o Kalepo; na matou faamu foi Sekeleka i le afi.

verses.en: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita ia te ia, E te ta'ita'i ifo ea ia te au i lena ‘au? Ona fai mai lea o ia, Ina tauto ia i le Atua ia te au, e te le fasioti ia te au, e te le tuuina atu foi aʻu i le lima o loʻu alii, ona ou ta‘ita‘i ifo lea ia te oe i lena “au.

verses.en: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
verses.sm: Ua ia Taa“ ifo ia te ia, faauta, o loo salalau i latou i le fogaeleele uma, o loo aai, ma feinu, ma sisiva, ona o le vete e tele ua latou aumaia mai le nuu o Filisitia, ma le nuu o Iuta.

verses.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
verses.sm: Ona fasia lea o i latou e Tavita e afua i le segisegi o le taeao ua 00 i le afiafi o le tasi aso; ua le sao so latou e toatasi, na o taulelea e toafa galau sa tietie i kamela, ma latou sosola.

verses.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verses.sm: Ona maua lea e Tavita mea uma na ave e Amaleka, ma ana ava e toalua ua maua e Tavita.

verses.en: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
verses.sm: Ua leai sa latou mea ua le iloa, o se mea itiiti po o se mea tele, o atalii ma afafine, o vete ma mea uma na ave e i latou, ua toe au mai uma e Tavita.

verses.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
verses.sm: Ua ave e Tavita mamoe uma ma povi, ua latou tutuli atu i luma o le tasi lafu, ma ua latou fai ane, O vete nei a Tavita.

verses.en: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
verses.sm: Oa oo atu Tavita i tagata e lua selau sa le lava ona mulimuli atu ia Tavita, sa nonofo i le alia o Pesora; na o mai i latou e faafetaiai ia Tavita, e faafetaiai foi i le nuu sa ia te ia; ua faalatalata atu Tavita i le nuu, ona alofa atu lea o ia ia te i latou.

verses.en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea tagata agaleaga uma ma e ulavavale o le nuu na o ma Tavita, ua faapea, Ona ua le 6 i latou ma i tatou, o le mea lea tatou te le avatu ai ia te i latou ni vete na matou fao mai, na ona taitasi ma ta‘ita‘i atu lana avà ma ana fanau, ma ia latou 6.

verses.en: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
verses.sm: A ua fai atu Tavita, O°u uso e, aua le faapea ona fai i mea ua foai mai e le ALII ia te i tatou; ma na leoleo ia te i tatou, ma tuuina mai i o tatou lima le ‘au na o mai ia te i tatou.

verses.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verses.sm: O ai foi se faalogo ia te outou i lenei mea? aua e tusa le vaegaoa o le na alu ifo i le taua, ma le vaegáoa o lé na faamuli i oa, e faagatasi lava o latou vaegáoa.

verses.en: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
verses.sm: Na afua mai i lea aso, ua faatuina lenei mea e fai ma tulafono ma masani ia Isaraelú, ua oo i le aso nei.

verses.en: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;
verses.sm: Ua oo atu Tavita i Sekeleka, ona avatu ai lea e ia o mea o le vete i toeaina o Iuta o ana uo, ua faapea atu, Faauta, o le mea alofa ia te outou ai le vete na maua i fili o le ALII;

verses.en: To them which were in Beth-el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
verses.sm: mo e i Peteli, mo e i Ramota i le itu i toga, mo e i Taura,

verses.en: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
verses.sm: mo e i Aroeru, mo e i Sefemo, mo e i Esetemoa,

verses.en: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.sm: mo e i Rakala, mo e i aai o sa Ieramaelù, mo ei aai o sa Keni,

verses.en: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,
verses.sm: mo e Horema, mo e i Koroasa, mo e i Ataka,

verses.en: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
verses.sm: mo e i Heperona, ma mea uma sa fealuai ai Tavita, o ia ma ona tagata. Ua oti Saulo ma ona atalii i le taua Ua tau
